card.name: Year-end phrasing and cross-reference 'see'
card.fires_on: The word 'year' or 'the' in phrases like "at year's end" and "first half of the year" in human-rights report text. Also 'see' inside bracketed label cross-references like "[see Adverse Reactions (6.1)".

modes.label: Year in country reports
modes.description: Fires on 'year' or 'the' in phrases about the reporting year, such as 'at year's end' or 'during the year'.
modes.example: The 18 villagers were imprisoned and awaited trial at<< year>>'s end.

modes.label: See in label cross-references
modes.description: Fires on 'see' opening a bracketed pointer to another label section.

card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to name a time span like the year or point the reader to another section.
